decisions.reason: As an adjacent extension to the coolant and fluid-management portfolio, it likely has modest carrying cost and strategic option value, but its somewhat less central fit and the firm's many other innovation options raise the chance of discontinuation if demand stayed weak.

This hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's core filtration know-how and installed-customer base, so under real-options logic management would usually keep it unless clear negative market feedback had already emerged.

The gravity band coolant filter is close to the established product family and can be supported through existing engineering, production and service structures, making the option to stay in the market more valuable than the likely cost of carrying it.
